meta.name: cavecrew
meta.description: When to delegate to `cavecrew-investigator` (locate code), `cavecrew-builder` (1-2 file edit) or `cavecrew-reviewer` (diff review) instead of working inline or using `Explore`. Their output is compressed, so main context lasts longer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需分派子代理处理代码定位、修改与审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想通过子代理分工节省上下文。
copy.tagline_en: Delegate to sub-agents for code search, edits, and reviews to save context.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI and want to manage context by delegating tasks to sub-agents.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把任务交给三个子代理之一:cavecrew-investigator 定位代码、cavecrew-builder 改 1~2 个文件、cavecrew-reviewer 审 diff。它们只回结构化短结果,主上下文占用更少。
howto.when: 当你要查代码在哪、做小范围改动或审 diff 时,会转给对应子代理;新功能、3 个以上文件、跨文件重构则留在主线程,或用原生 Explore / Code Reviewer。

say.text: 帮我找到 parseConfig 定义在哪、谁调用了它
say.note: 返回 路径:行号 + 符号 的清单

say.text: 把 src/a.ts 第 20 行这个判断改成提前返回
say.note: 回一行改动摘要和校验结果

say.text: 审查我当前的 diff,找出 bug
say.note: 按文件行号给出分级问题列表

howto.what_en: Claude routes work to one of three subagents: cavecrew-investigator locates code, cavecrew-builder edits 1-2 files, cavecrew-reviewer reviews a diff. They return only compressed structured output, so main context shrinks per delegation.
howto.when_en: Use it when locating code, making a small edit, or reviewing a diff; for new features, 3+ files, or cross-cutting refactors stay in the main thread or use vanilla Explore / Code Reviewer.

say_en.text: Find where parseConfig is defined and who calls it
In src/a.ts line 20, make this check return early
say_en.note: Returns a one-line change plus verify result

say_en.text: Review my current diff and find bugs
